_note: TASK-MOTION-001 numeric contract. Every number here is either measured on this machine (see _measured) or derived from the frozen traveler camera. Codex must implement these values verbatim; any change needs a line in the delivery report saying which number changed and the measurement that justified it.

_measured.headless_render_cost: a 1920x1080 capture of the Atlas traveler scene did not complete 90 frames in 20 min under --headless (>7 s/frame); an empty SceneTree does 40 frames in 258 ms (6.5 ms/frame). The gate MUST run windowed.

wind.formula: t = anim_t<0 ? TIME : anim_t; phase = o.x*0.72 + o.z*0.63 (o = MODEL_MATRIX[3].xyz, per-instance for MultiMesh); lever = pow(max(VERTEX.y,0.0), wind_stiff); move = (sin(t*1.1+phase) + 0.4*sin(t*1.8+phase*1.6)) * wind_amp * wind_gust * lever; VERTEX.x += move*1.0; VERTEX.z += move*0.38;
wind.why_cantilever_not_root_cut: the prototypes have no UV2 and no CUSTOM channel (verified: COLOR_0/NORMAL/POSITION only), so a per-vertex root height would mean re-authoring 8 GLBs; pow(y,stiff) gives the same rigid base with C1 continuity across the trunk/canopy seam and needs no new attribute.

trunk._note: NEW material kind; same params as plants so the trunk and canopy bend as one object

cypress._note: 2500 of 6655 trees; a fir must read stiff

wind.why_current_is_invisible: current wind_strength 0.014 with lever=max(VERTEX.y,0) on a 1.65u-local canopy at instance scale 0.52 gives 0.0070 u of travel = 1.06 px at 11 u and 0.47 px at 25 u. Sub-2-px motion at 1080p is not perceptible; that is the measured reason the frame reads dead.

gust.note: audio reads gust(t+0.35), shaders read gust(t) -> you hear the gust arrive before the leaves answer

instance_custom.packing: R=phase jitter 0..1, G=amp multiplier 0.75..1.25, B=gust response 0.6..1.4, A=reserved

clouds.method: node translation in _process, NOT a shader offset
clouds.why_node: per-cloud parallax speeds need per-node state anyway; a shader offset invalidates the AABB and these are the largest meshes in the frame; 9-14 transform writes per frame is free
clouds.reference: Little Planet = one revolution in 17.5 min; the near band at 12.6 min per frame width is the same tempo

wrap.rule: reset only outside the 60-deg horizontal frustum plus the cloud's half width

spin.why: a faceted cloud that spins reads as a rotating solid; a yaw sway only re-catches the light

clouds.shadows: stay off. Directional shadow max distance is 60 u with 2 splits, so a 40-110 u cloud shadow either misses or eats the split budget; if a cloud shadow is wanted later, do it as a scrolling multiply in the terrain shader.

light.why_attenuation_1_6: Godot att = max(1-(d/r)^4,0)^2 * d^-att; at att=2.0 a face 0.25 u away gets 16x the 1 u value and blows out, 1.6 gives 9.2x

shadow.why: T2 is entirely held up by firelight shadows, and all 5 prototype point lights cast none. Godot's OmniLight defaults (bias 0.1 / normal_bias 1.0) push the shadow off the caster at this scale, exactly as the 1.4 normal_bias did for the sun.

flicker.noise: FastNoiseLite, seed 20260918, get_noise_1d(t*13.0) - never randf() per frame (that strobes)

core_mesh.signal: same noise term as the light

particles.why: ParticleProcessMaterial.turbulence_* exists and CPUParticles3D has no turbulence at all (verified on 4.7.1). Leaves that fall in straight lines are the single cheapest-looking failure, and turbulence is the fix. GPUParticlesCollisionHeightField3D (also Forward+ only) lets leaves land instead of sinking. Both are 1 draw call either way.

leaves.draw_order: INDEX (quads are opaque, no sorting needed)
leaves.why_gravity: a leaf's terminal velocity is ~1 m/s; -9.8 drops it like a stone
leaves.mesh: QuadMesh 0.085 x 0.055 u (camp) / 0.030 x 0.020 u (atlas view), 2 tris

sparks.why_positive_gravity: embers ride the thermal; damping kills them at the top
sparks.scale_curve: falls to 0 at end of life

light_drift.rule: no day-night cycle; a single locked time of day that breathes

periods_s.why: incommensurate, so the loop is 9.4 h and never reads as a cycle; neither shares a period with the 756 s cloud crossing

light_drift.shadow_quantization_note: an 8192 map over 60 u is 0.0073 u per texel = 1.1 px at 11 u; a 0.0018 deg/frame sun rotation snaps a texel every ~4 s, which is visible on a long straight shadow edge. Keep shadow_blur 0.8 and light_angular_distance 0.35 so the edge spans >=2 texels.

rivers.current: StandardMaterial3D #5f9d9d, zero motion, and ribbons() writes no UV at all
rivers.change: add u=accumulated arclength, v=across to ribbons() (3 lines), then a shader that scrolls along u
rivers.no_vertex_displacement: the ribbons are 0.065 u wide = 10 px; displacement would only alias

lake_sea.existing_shader_already_animates: atlas_water.gdshader normals at TIME*0.42/0.34 and a sparkle at TIME*0.45 - tuned to the 190 u sea, so at traveler framing the sparkle period is ~1.4 u = 210 px and reads as slow blobs
lake_sea.keep: depth_draw_always + the opaque_depth trick; do NOT stack a second translucent plane (the shader's own comment warns)

birds.reason: User decision: the distant goose flock effect is abandoned and is not loaded by MotionDirector.

audio_coupling.single_signal_source: MotionDirector publishes gust(t) and fire_flare(t); shaders, particles and audio all read the same functions

fire_crackle.trigger: fire_flare crossing 0.55 rising, plus a Poisson trickle at 1.9/s
fire_crackle.rule: never a pop without a brightening

audio_coupling.fire_bed: AudioStreamPlayer3D at the fire; reuse the unit_size numbers from scratchpad/probe/atten_proj rather than guessing
audio_coupling.water: steady AudioStreamPlayer3D loop; do NOT couple it to the wave sines
audio_coupling.leaf_rustle: NOT a separate sound - it is the wind loop's high band

gate.run_mode: WINDOWED (no --headless), 1920x1080, --fixed-fps 30, Engine.max_fps 0, use_taa=false, screen_space_aa=DISABLED, msaa_3d=4x, particles use_fixed_seed=true

metric.thinning: greedy, no two kept cells share an edge or a corner (8-neighbourhood)

gate.threshold_derivation: measured on the real frame docs/design/shanhe-luren/lookdev/traveler-grandeur-dusk-1499x937.png: a synthetic 2.6 px shift of the frame trips 67 of 84 cells / 14 non-adjacent; freezing rows 0-2 (sky and peaks) still gives 11. The metric is insensitive to pixel_threshold over 3..12 and to cell_fraction over 0.002..0.02, so 6 / 0.004 sit in the flat middle. M=8 leaves headroom for the fact that only part of each cell's area actually moves.
gate.per_item_rule: each item alone, 10 s, must produce >=1 live cell inside its own expected region (clouds rows 0-2; fire/sparks the 2x2 cells around the unprojected fire position; water the cells containing the river/lake; wind rows 3-6)
gate.light_drift_own_check: mean luminance at t=0 vs t=57 s differs by 1.2-4.0%, and no single 1.0 s pair differs by more than 0.35%
gate.framerate_independence: the same engine time at max_fps 30 vs 120 -> mean |diff| <= 2/255 on 6 sampled frames
gate.determinism: two identical gate runs -> mean |diff| <= 1/255 on all 61 frames
gate.frozen_geometry: with only the wind layer on, the city-core cells must show 0 live cells
gate.fire_shadow_proof: fire on: a 16x16 patch in the fire-side shadow of a rock is >=22% darker than a 16x16 patch at the same distance on the lit side; with shadow_enabled=false the two patches differ by <=6%
